answers.core: This needs to be in the core loop of the engine in order to do per-frame updates in the physics.
answers.workaround: It's possible an autoload could handle this in _process(), but I'm not sure if that is the appropriate place to do things like move enemies around, and ideally this would happen before the animations play so there's not a delay in feedback.  Could be possible, though.

title: Allow locking the physics step to the rendered frame rate
